messages:
maria: Kicking off DP FastPath plan — pulling together recruitment + ops for a small, high-touch beta. Target 8–12 partners. Timeline: outreach (2w), onboarding (1w), trial (3w), canary (1w).
ash: Are those partners mostly VPC/private or Dedicated reservations?
maria: Mix — 60% Dedicated, 40% Private preview. Need to validate our onboarding checklist for both.
ken: Ops note: Dedicated partners need reserved capacity slots. Can we pre-allocate 2 GPUs per partner during trial window?
sarah: We should cap at 1 GPU for light trials; extra for heavy evals. Also we need a clear success rubric for each partner.
robin: Proposed success metrics: integration completeness, avg latency within 10% of benchmark, failing-rate <0.5%, feedback NPS >= 7.
maria: +1 to that rubric. Also add prompt-regression checks and at least one blocked-case reproduction for each partner.
ash: On the technical gate: require a smoke test that runs <5min and validates: auth, model selection, function-calling, streaming. Example command:
```
# smoke test
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
maria: Good. Who owns outreach message and incentive tiers?
ken: I'll own outreach ops. Incentives: $1500 credit + 1:1 onboarding session, plus co-marketing option.
sarah: Might be worth offering priority support during trial — 2hr SLA for critical incidents.
robin: Agree. Also want a committed feedback cadence: weekly async reports + 2 live syncs (mid-trial + final).
maria: Can we add an internal gating checklist? I'll draft. Items: NDA signed, network whitelisting, KMS access confirmed, smoke tests pass, eval prompt set delivered.
ash: For private deployments, include an infra readiness signoff from infra-priv. I'll ping @ash for that when we have candidate.
ken: deploy-bot: Scheduled reminder set: outreach email -> 2026-05-03 10:00 UTC :bell:
maria: Draft outreach copy attached in thread — please add comments.
sarah: Quick ask: elastic intake window — do we allow rolling admits or fixed cohort? Rolling seems easier ops-wise.
robin: Rolling for capacity reasons, but cap concurrent partners to 6 to avoid overcommit.
maria: Final ask: acceptance criteria for launch to public beta: 80% of partners pass success metrics, no critical regressions across eval prompt set, and ops runbook verified.
ash: Sounds good. I'll update the task board and tag owners.
maria: Thanks all — will post the checklist update by end of day. :thumbsup:
